fields.parent_observation_id: nullable binary[50], reference to an original observation
fields.record_id: binary[50], unique, equal to observation_id for an original
fields.sequence_id: binary[25], exact primary identity in the original registry
fields.global_label: int8, copied from D1 for originals
fields.split: TRAIN, VALIDATION or TEST, copied from D1 for originals
fields.prott5_embedding_id: reference to the registry, profile ID followed by ':' and exact primary
fields.secondarybert_embedding_id: reference to the registry, profile ID followed by ':' and exact C/H/E key
fields.embedding_status: verified_existing for current originals with both certified references

future_lineage_contract.split_and_group: A related record inherits the group and partition of its certified parent
future_lineage_contract.label_evidence: Original label evidence pertains to the original. Related records require their own evidence status
future_lineage_contract.identifier_policy: Assign new record types their own domain-separated, versioned deterministic identity before publication

fields.embedding_id: unique profile ID and exact input key
fields.model_profile_id: reference to a versioned profile in manifest.json
fields.dimension: uint16, 1024 for ProtT5 or 768 for SecondaryBERT
fields.shard: nullable uint16, index into the modality's referenced shards
fields.row_offset: nullable uint32, vector row within certified shard

statuses.calculated: Calculation recorded with its evidence; admissible only after independent correspondence is certified

embedding_registry.usage_gate: Match exact input key, versioned model profile, dimension and certified address. Reject inadmissible states and missing evidence.

calculation_journal.scope: Events and provenance only. Publication requires independent evidence and an updated certified release.

synthetic_lineage_harness.scope: Synthetic fixture identities and temporary databases only
synthetic_lineage_harness.identity: synthetic:derived: plus SHA-256 of canonical JSON array [nap.synthetic.lineage.v1, parent_observation_id, sequence_id]
synthetic_lineage_harness.idempotence: Identical record is replayable; changes under the same identifier are rejected
